subject: Follow-up: DPA & evidence requests from discovery call
messages:
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
From: Lauren Barnes <lauren@medcore.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medcore.com
Subject: Follow-up: DPA clarifications and evidence requests

Hannah — thanks for the productive demo earlier. Quick recap + asks from Legal/Compliance so we can move toward procurement: 

1) Controller vs Processor: Please confirm Redwood's position on which party is controller for (a) model outputs we surface to end users, and (b) telemetry/usage logs generated during inference. Our counsel wants explicit language for both.

2) Subprocessors: We need the current subprocessor inventory and your notification window for adding a new subprocessor (and whether we can opt out of specific ones).

3) Breach notification: Our policy requires notification within 48 hours for incidents affecting customer PII. Can you confirm Redwood's breach notification SLA and whether that can be contractually committed?

4) Data residency & retention: We need EU-residency for EU-subject data. What hosting options will guarantee residency, and what are default retention windows for logs/audit trails? Can retention be configured per-tenant?

5) Evidence: Please provide SOC 2 (Type II) report, an example audit-log extract (PII redacted), and brief notes on encryption at rest / KMS handling.

Next steps: Can you send a short DPA summary mapping the roles above + a deliverable list and estimated timelines? Would like legal-to-legal call if needed.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Barnes | Head of Security & Privacy
MedCore Health

--
Attachment: none
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 18:05:00 -0700
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Barnes <lauren@medcore.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA clarifications and evidence requests

Lauren — really appreciate the clear list. Below is a concise action plan; we can follow with legal-to-legal if helpful.

Quick answers up front:
- Controller/Processor: Redwood operates as a processor for user-provided customer data and model inputs; customers retain control over application-level data processed for their tenants. For model outputs, Redwood processes according to customer configuration and treats outputs as customer data in the context of the DPA. We'll provide proposed wording for both items.
- Subprocessors: We'll attach the current inventory and propose a 30-day prior-notice window for new subprocessors (with the option for customers to request a reasonable mitigation and, in rare cases, contractually opt out for specific subprocessors).
- Breach notification: Redwood's internal SLA is 48 hours for preliminary notification; we normally commit 72 hours in standard templates but can escalate to 48 hours for enterprise agreements.
- Residency & retention: We offer EU region deployments to guarantee residency. Default audit/log retention is 90 days; retention is configurable per-tenant up to 24 months with a paid retention add-on.

Deliverables and timeline (we'll aim for 3 business days):
1) DPA one-page role map + proposed clause language (PDF) — attached: redwood_dpa_summary.pdf
2) Subprocessor inventory CSV — attached: subprocessor_list_2027-06-20.csv
3) SOC 2 report link and redacted sample audit log extract — links below / will provide sample CSV once legal approves redaction
4) Proposed contract clause redlines (if needed) — Marcus (cc'd) will draft recommendations for the breach/notification windows

Let me know available times for legal-to-legal this week. If useful I can include our Security PM and Product Compliance as well.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood_dpa_summary.pdf; subprocessor_list_2027-06-20.csv
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Lauren Barnes <lauren@medcore.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA clarifications and evidence requests — proposed language & timeline

Hi Lauren, Hannah — adding a few concrete proposals so Legal has something to react to quickly. I'm Neha (Sales Ops) and will shepherd the procurement requirements.

Proposed items we can include in the DPA / SOW: 
- Breach notification: Redwood agrees to provide preliminary notification to Customer within 48 hours of becoming aware of an incident materially affecting Customer PII; substantive follow-up (root cause + mitigation) to follow within 14 calendar days.
- Subprocessor changes: Redwood will provide at least 30 days' notice of new subprocessors and allow Customer to object; for critical objections we commit to engage on mitigation options (alternative isolated deployment or termination of the subprocessor relationship where feasible).
- Controller/Processor mapping: Add explicit definitions: Customer = Controller for customer-provided data and application-level outputs; Redwood = Processor for hosting, storage, and inference operations. Include example scenarios in an appendix.
- Logs & retention: Default 90-day retention for request/response logs and audit trails; configurable per-tenant up to 24 months with an add-on. We can accept an SLA to preserve logs for a 90-day incident investigation window.

Artifacts we will deliver (ETA: 3 business days):
- Proposed DPA clauses (attached): proposed_dpa_clauses.docx
- SOC 2 (Type II) 2026 report (link) and an example audit-log extract (PII redacted) — sample-audit-log-extract.csv (we'll redact before sending if needed)
- Short note on KMS/encryption practices and FAQ on data residency options

If all good, Hannah — I'd plan to send the DocuSign-ready DPA + DocuSign envelope link once Lauren confirms the clause language. Happy to jump on a 30-minute legal-to-legal call; what windows work for you, Lauren?

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: proposed_dpa_clauses.docx
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
From: Lauren Barnes <lauren@medcore.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medcore.com
Subject: Re: Follow-up: DPA & evidence requests from discovery call

Thanks — that timeline works for us. A few notes from Legal: 
• 48-hour preliminary notification + 14-day substantive follow-up is acceptable.
• Please remove any language that would give Redwood rights to use aggregated customer outputs for model training without explicit opt-in; Legal wants that redlined.
• We will need a short sample audit log extract (CSV) that shows timestamp, tenant id, request id, and redacted prompt/output fields.

Our compliance contact: Samir Patel (samir.patel@medcore.com). Please include him on the artifact delivery and the legal-to-legal invite.

Once we have the DPA draft and the sample log extract I'll put this to our procurement queue — looking forward to the DocuSign link.

Best,
Lauren Barnes
Head of Security & Privacy | MedCore Health
